systems: Ansible --tags/--limit: templating is lazy, so a skipped task with an undefined variable does not fail the play
Terraform -target: the graph is narrowed to the targeted resources and their dependencies before non-targeted resources are evaluated
Puppet --tags: the whole catalog is compiled before tags filter what is applied, so a failed lookup anywhere fails the run
